take_quality.reason: Clipped at the boundary. Tom listened to the Welsh north Pod 1 recordings on 2026-08-23 and ruled: "Aran's are all junk. All clipped badly at either or both ends" — and, on whether to salvage any: "None are salvageable. It's not even worth looking."

evidence.basis: Tom's ear. NO per-clip measurement was made for this mark and none should be read into it — the ruling was course-wide for this recordist and the marking is wholesale.
evidence.corroboration: A boundary measurement taken on 18 of these clips while building the gate found lead margins of 0.00-0.08s and tail margins of 0.015-0.264s, against 0.35s / 0.41s on the Catrin take Tom called perfect. Every one of Aran's takes predates the 2026-08-21 trim-margin fix (5102c0780) and went through the old flush cut.
evidence.gate: services/recording-speech-gate.cjs, checkTakeBoundaries — would now refuse this take at save time
